Package com.github.query4j.optimizer.join

Class JoinReorderSuggestion

java.lang.Object
com.github.query4j.optimizer.join.JoinReorderSuggestion
public final class JoinReorderSuggestion extends Object
Immutable suggestion for join reordering to minimize intermediate result sizes and improve query performance. Analyzes join graph and predicate selectivity to recommend optimal join sequence.
Since:
1.0.0
